LPWAN_Communication.label: LPWAN Communication
LPWAN_Communication.description: The uCIFI communication object provides attributes related to the communication on the LPWAN network, including multicast grouping.

Type_of_network.label: Type of network
Type_of_network.description: Type of LPWAN communication network (e.g. LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, wireless mesh, power line).

Network_address.label: Network address
Network_address.description: Address of the device on the LPWAN network.

Secondary_network_address.label: Secondary network address
Secondary_network_address.description: Secondary address used to communicate with the device on the LPWAN network.

MAC_address.label: MAC address
MAC_address.description: IEEE MAC address of the device.

Peer_address.label: Peer address
Peer_address.description: Address of a peer (e.g. a router, a mesh node, a gateway).

Multicast_group_address.label: Multicast group address
Multicast_group_address.description: Group address from which the  device should accept incoming messages and/or commands.

Multicast_group_key.label: Multicast group key
Multicast_group_key.description: Security key (e.g. AES128) to be shared with other members to be part of a multicast group.

Data_rate.label: Data rate
Data_rate.description: Data rate of the communication used on the LPWAN network.

Transmit_power.label: Transmit power
Transmit_power.description: Transmit power (also called TxPower) used by the device on the LPWAN network in decibel per milliwatt.

Frequency.label: Frequency
Frequency.description: Frequency of the wireless communication used on the LPWAN network.

Session_time.label: Session time
Session_time.description: Starting time of the multicast session. The device shall not accept incoming messages before this time or after this time + session duration.

Session_duration.label: Session duration
Session_duration.description: Duration of the multicast session. The device shall accept incoming messages only during this session duration time, starting at "Session time".

Mesh_node.label: Mesh node
Mesh_node.description: Set to True if the device is a mesh node that should repeat incoming messages on a mesh network.

Maximum_repeat_time.label: Maximum repeat time
Maximum_repeat_time.description: Maximum number of times a message should be repeated within a mesh network.

Number_of_repeats.label: Number of repeats
Number_of_repeats.description: Number of mesh nodes between the device and the destination device (e.g. another device or a router) including the destination node, on a mesh network.

Signal_to_noise_ratio.label: Signal to noise ratio
Signal_to_noise_ratio.description: Ratio of signal power to the noise power.

Communication_failure.label: Communication failure
Communication_failure.description: Set to True when the device can't communicate properly.

Received_Signal_Strength_Indication.label: Received Signal Strength Indication
Received_Signal_Strength_Indication.description: Signal strength of the communication network measured by the device (a.k.a. RSSI or signal level).

Current_Communication_Operator.label: Current Communication Operator
Current_Communication_Operator.description: Device’s current communication operator. Communication operators could be private operators. Thus this resource is free text format and does not use Mobile Network Code or equivalent.

Integrated_Circuit_Card_Identifier.label: Integrated Circuit Card Identifier
Integrated_Circuit_Card_Identifier.description: Unique identifier used to identify a communication SIM card. The ICCID is defined by the ITU-T recommendation E.118 as the Primary Account Number, composed of 19 or 20 characters containing the ISO Industry Identifier, country code, issuer identity, account ID, and other data which allows the network operator to identify the card.
